objective: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.

description: I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.
Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.
Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
completion: And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!
Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, <name>.
